deviations: The case bar's subtitle: the board shows a case description and trial month; the API has neither, the page shows the case type and due date. The artboard is rendered with the page's subtitle (artboardCss). Bar overrides are scoped to trial screens in trial.css (52px hit areas stay).

Document names (GP prescriptions, February blood result, ...) come from the pack's source_types words; the mock answers carry a pack with those words. The API gives a source type and a date, never free text, so the board's 'out-of-hours record, 22 April' prints as the label plus the date as 22 Apr 2024.
Paragraph numbers: the board shows 5.12; the API returns whole numbers. The mock answers use the board's strings. Page numbers print p.87 where the board writes p.087 (shared PageRef rule).

'Add a new version of the trial bundle' sits as a quiet button at the left of the action row (the board has no way to replace the bundle); 'Show every page' and 'Download as a spreadsheet' sit after 'and 205 more'.
Short dates follow the browser's en-GB wording (24 Sept 2024); the board writes 24 Sep.
Missing-pages heading icon and the matched/missing numbers are as drawn; the 'Tell the solicitor' word comes from the pack's instructing party type (mock case is instructed by a lawyer).
